hitPoints.atHigherLevels: 1d6 (or 4) + your Constitution modifier per sorcerer level after 1st

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: An event in your past, or in your lineage, gave you an inherent magical ability. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You know a number of sorcerer spells equal to your sorcerer level. You can change known spells whenever you gain a level.

features.name: Cantrips (Sorcerer)
features.description: You know 4 cantrips (Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation are common defaults). You learn additional cantrips at higher levels.

features.name: Sorcery Points
features.description: You have Sorcery Points equal to your sorcerer level. They fuel Metamagic. You regain all Sorcery Points on a long rest.

features.name: Flexible Casting
features.description: Convert sorcery points ↔ spell slots: 1 SP = 1st-level slot; 2 SP = 2nd; 3 SP = 3rd; etc. (max 5th); create bonus action spell slots: 1 SP = 1st slot; reverse: 1 SP from a slot = slot level.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: Choose two Metamagic options from: Careful Spell, Distant Spell, Empowered Spell, Extended Spell, Heightened Spell, Quickened Spell, Seeking Spell, Subtle Spell, Twinned Spell. You gain a third at 10th level and a fourth at 17th.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Choose a Sorcerous Origin: Draconic Bloodline or Wild Magic.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one score by 2, or two by 1. Max 20.

features.name: Font of Magic (Optional rename of Sorcery)
features.description: You regain 1 SP per Long Rest extension if you choose to spend spell slots only.

subclasses.name: Clockwork Soul

features.name: Clockwork Magic
features.description: Gain 2 sorcery points to spend on Clockwork Spells at 1st level or higher.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.description: Advantage on CON saves; reroll attack rolls; restore d6 sorcery points; spend 1 sorcery point to take an extra action.

features.name: Watcher's Will
features.description: React to attack / save with Advantage; 10 swifty uses per day.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.description: Cast Magnificent Mansion / Mighty Fortress / Wall of Force once per long rest.

features.name: Capstone
features.description: Enchant mechanical advantage to allies.

subclasses.description: Your magic comes from the blessed, ordered realms of Mechanus.

subclasses.name: Draconic Bloodline
subclasses.description: Your innate magic comes from draconic blood. Choose a dragon type (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder).

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.description: You learn Draconic language. Choose a chromatic dragon damage type; your sorcerer spells of that damage type gain +1 damage per spell level.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: Hit points +1 per sorcerer level (instead of +1 HP total). AC = 13 + DEX mod when not wearing armor.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: As a bonus action, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of a sorcerer spell that deals your chosen draconic damage type. Once per short rest, you can also gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour (concentration).

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: You gain a flying speed of 60 feet. You cannot benefit from this feature if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: As an action, exude an aura of awe or fear for 1 minute (concentration). WIS save vs your DC or charmed (awe) or frightened (fear) for those within 60 ft. Recharges on short rest.

subclasses.name: Lunar Sorcery

features.name: Lunar Magic
features.description: Cast 3 cantrips from lunar list; gain 4 d6 lunar sorcery points.

features.name: Crescent Moon
features.description: Cast Silence and Color Spray with lunar sorcery points (1 each).

features.name: Full Moon
features.description: Cast Moonbeam and Faerie Fire with lunar sorcery points (2 each).

features.name: New Moon
features.description: Apply diff to attacks; darkvision 120 ft; darkness gained.

features.name: Shield of the Moon
features.description: Cast Heroes' Feast and Mass Heal once per long rest.

subclasses.description: You draw your magic from the moon, channeling its various phases.

subclasses.name: Storm Sorcery

features.name: Storm Magic
features.description: 5 sorcery points Lightning damage on each lightning spell cast.

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.description: After casting spell of 1st+ level, teleport 10 ft as bonus action.

features.name: Lightning Strike
features.description: Channel Divinity-like: bonus action lightning damage to one target.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.description: Resistance to thunder and lightning; magic damage from same type to creatures within 10 ft.

features.name: Soul of the Storm
features.description: Cast Control Weather and Storm of Vengeance once per long rest.

features.name: Wind Soul
features.description: Permanent flight, resistances, immunity to gas; reduces damage type by 60 ft.

subclasses.description: You are the storm made flesh. Your magic is wild, powerful, and uncontrolled.

subclasses.name: Wild Magic
subclasses.description: Your magic derives from untamed forces. Wild Magic Surge may trigger when you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. On a 1, the DM chooses a surge effect from the Wild Magic table (random flavor list).

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: You can give yourself advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. You must then finish a long rest before using this feature again. The DM may also have you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table afterward.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: As a reaction when another creature you can see rolls an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll 1d4 and add or subtract it from the result.

features.name: Controlled Surge
features.description: When you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can choose the result (instead of rolling).

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.description: When you apply a Metamagic option to a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, you can roll on the Wild Magic Surge table; if the result is a damage spell, the spell deals maximum damage.

subclasses.name: Linaje Dracónico
subclasses.description: Tu magia proviene de sangre dracónica; eliges un tipo: ácido, frío, fuego, eléctrico, veneno, trueno.

features.name: Ancestro dragón
features.description: Aprendes Dracónico; +1 daño por nivel de conjuro en conjuros de tu tipo.

features.name: Resiliencia dracónica
features.description: +1 PG por nivel de hechicero; CA = 13 + DES sin armadura.

features.name: Afinidad elemental
features.description: Acción adicional: añade mod CAR a un daño de conjuro de tu tipo. Uso por descanso corto: resistencia a ese daño 1 hora.

features.name: Alas de dragón
features.description: Velocidad de vuelo 18 m sin armadura media o pesada.

subclasses.name: Magia Salvaje
subclasses.description: Tu magia proviene de fuerzas indómitas; puede desatar Oleadas de Magia Salvaje.

features.name: Oleada de Magia Salvaje
features.description: Tras lanzar un conjuro de hechicero nivel 1+, el DM puede tirar d20 y en 1 hay una oleada.

features.name: Mareas del caos
features.description: Ventaja en una tirada por descanso largo; tras ello posible oleada.

features.name: Doblar la suerte
features.description: Reacción: 1 PH para sumar/restando 1d4 a una tirada de otra criatura.
